note: Committed scenario-to-test coverage mapping required by SPECIFICATION/non-functional-requirements.md §"Top-of-pyramid discipline". Each load-bearing scenario in SPECIFICATION/scenarios.md is classified browser-observable (>=1 Playwright identifier) or non-browser-exercisable (a named non-Playwright category, >=1 test identifier, and a rationale for why a Playwright mapping would mislead). Verified by scripts/check-scenarios.ts (bun run check:scenarios) inside bun run check. Later-phase scenarios are excluded until a future proposed change activates them. Identifier grammar: "<repo-relative test file>.ts > <test title>"; Playwright files live under e2e/ or end in .e2e.ts, non-browser tests end in .test.ts/.spec.ts. Test identifiers are armed: their file resolution activates when first-party src/** product source lands.

mappings.scenario: Governed data preserves the predecessor data shape
tests: src/lib/data/import.test.ts > preserves the predecessor about/header/section data shape
mappings.rationale: The predecessor-to-governed data-shape mapping is a transform invariant over the data source with no faithful browser rendering; a Playwright mapping would exercise the UI instead of the shape.

mappings.scenario: Import transcribes the predecessor production content
tests: src/lib/data/import.test.ts > transcribes the predecessor production content into data/resume.yml
mappings.rationale: Import transcription is a data-source fidelity invariant verified by comparing the governed source against the predecessor content; no visitor gesture exercises the import, so Playwright would mislead.

mappings.scenario: Malformed governed data is rejected at load
tests: src/lib/data/load.test.ts > malformed governed data fails the phase-1 build-time load
mappings.rationale: Under the phase-1 build-time load a malformed source fails the build/prerender so it never ships; the rejection happens before any page renders, so a Playwright test could never observe it.

mappings.scenario: Import derives stable item anchors deterministically
tests: src/lib/data/identifiers.test.ts > derives stable item anchors deterministically with collision suffixes
mappings.rationale: Deterministic anchor derivation is a pure-function invariant (also a property target); its visitor-observable use is covered by the deep-link scenarios, so a Playwright mapping here would misattribute the derivation to the UI.

mappings.scenario: Committed governed source round-trips the pinned production inventory
tests: src/lib/data/inventory.test.ts > round-trips the pinned production inventory (18 keys, 16 sections, 74 items)
mappings.rationale: Round-tripping the pinned 18-key/16-section/74-item inventory is a data-fidelity invariant with no faithful browser rendering; Playwright would test presentation, not the round-trip.

mappings.scenario: Phase-1 data load tolerates deferred optional collections
tests: src/lib/data/load.test.ts > tolerates deferred skills/relationships/rich-metadata collections as empty
mappings.rationale: Tolerating absent skills/relationships/rich-metadata collections is a load/transform invariant asserted at the data contract, not through a visitor gesture.

mappings.scenario: Search projection is generated without a browser DOM
tests: src/lib/search/projection.test.ts > generates the plain-text projection without document or window
mappings.rationale: The projection is generated where document and window are unavailable; mapping it to a Playwright (browser DOM) test would contradict the very property under test.

mappings.scenario: Sections derive stable slugs used by Contents and offset anchors
tests: src/lib/data/slugs.test.ts > derives stable section slugs with -2/-3 collision suffixes
mappings.rationale: Slug derivation is a DOM-free deterministic function (also a property target); its use as a Contents link target and offset-anchor id is exercised by the interactive-render scenarios, so a Playwright mapping here would misattribute the derivation to the UI.

mappings.scenario: Invalid sort input falls back to default order
tests: src/lib/sort/section-sort.test.ts > an invalid sort selection falls back to canonical default order
mappings.rationale: An invalid sort selection is unreachable through the seven-option sort control, so no visitor gesture produces it; the fallback is a component-level guard best tested by a unit test.

mappings.scenario: Item dates render in predecessor format
playwright: e2e/rendering.e2e.ts > item dates render in the predecessor M.YYYY format with until/current fallbacks

mappings.scenario: Markdown renders consistently across modes
tests: src/lib/markdown/render.test.ts > interactive and static modes render byte-identical markdown
mappings.rationale: Byte-identical output across interactive and static modes is a cross-mode equivalence invariant asserted by comparing renderer output; a single visitor cannot observe both modes' bytes, so Playwright would mislead.

mappings.scenario: Governed data failure never ships a broken resume
tests: src/lib/data/load.test.ts > a governed data failure fails the build so the broken resume never ships
mappings.rationale: Under the phase-1 build-time load a data failure fails the build so the broken resume never reaches production; the guarantee is a build invariant with no rendered page for Playwright to observe.
